Subject: Kickoff: telemetry & SLO transfer (next steps)

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We're moving this into implementation next week and want to make sure the observability transfer is tightly scoped so our on-call team can run independently by EOW Oct 15. Primary asks from CloudScale:

- Transfer SLOs & alert routing (PagerDuty)
- Dashboard templates for latency/error budgets in Grafana
- Tracing hooks and instrumentation guidance for their async workers
- A short runbook for P1/P2 incidents (escalation matrix + playbooks)

I've attached our internal telemetry requirements spreadsheet and a draft SLO matrix (high level). Can Redwood own a short runbook template and a concrete list of traces/events we need instrumented for the async pipeline?

Can we schedule a focused 30-min working session directly with your CS/ops + engineering folks on Tue 10/05 at 11am PT? Samir and I will bring the CloudScale on-call lead.

Thanks,
Priya Raman
Director of Ops, CloudScale Inc.

Hi Priya —

Thanks — this looks straightforward. Tue 10/05 11am PT works for our team. Quick notes before the call so we can be efficient:

1) SLOs: we'll map your provided error/latency targets to three candidate alert thresholds (warn, ticket, page). We prefer keeping the page threshold tied to error budget burn rate + absolute latency SLA.

2) Dashboards: we'll bring a Grafana folder with templated panels (p95, p99 latency, error-rate by route, tokenization failures, kv-cache hit rate).

3) Tracing: recommend opentelemetry + a helper snippet we'll share during the session for async worker spans and parent/child correlation (trace_id propagation).

4) Runbook: we'll hand over an on-call runbook scaffold (P0/P1 playbook + escalation matrix). Marissa will own the runbook doc; Ben will validate PagerDuty routing config.

I attached our internal oncall-runbook-template.md for reference. Please confirm attendees for the 10/05 call and whether PagerDuty integration requires a service account.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
attachments: oncall-runbook-template.md

- Draft a minimal runbook (P0 checklist, run impact assessment, rollback steps).

Connor, can you validate the trace span names we'll recommend (span names + attributes) and drop a short opentelemetry snippet in the shared Drive before Tue? Ben, please confirm PagerDuty play names we usually recommend for dedicated capacity customers.

Marissa

Adding the trace snippet here (short):

-- code --
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.propagate import inject

tracer = trace.get_tracer(__name__)

with tracer.start_as_current_span("async_worker.process_job") as span:
    span.set_attribute("service.type", "async-worker")
    span.set_attribute("job.size", job.size)
    # ensure trace_id is propagated on downstream calls
    headers = {}
    inject(headers)
    downstream_call(headers=headers)
-- end code --

Span naming rationale: keep top-level operation names (async_worker.process_job) and add fine-grained attributes for routing and payload size. I'll upload a list of recommended attribute keys to the Drive link by EOD.

Connor
Principal SWE, Inference Runtime
